@AGENTS.md
# Tally

Tally is a billing platform for SaaS companies. Each organization (a tenant) keeps its customers, sells them plans, bills
them through subscriptions and invoices, takes payments through the payment gateway, and receives webhooks about what
happened. Its own staff work in the organization as members with roles. Go standard library only.

## Layout

| Package | What it does |
|---|---|
| `internal/store` | Everything Tally knows, in memory, safe for concurrent use. Every object belongs to one organization; methods that take an `orgID` only see that organization's objects. |
| `internal/money` | Currencies and amounts. Amounts are `int64` counts of the currency's minor unit (cents for USD), never floats. |
| `internal/billing` | Invoice arithmetic (`Compute`) and billing periods (`AddInterval`). No state. |
| `internal/payments` | Charges invoices through the payment `Gateway`; `Fake` is the gateway of tests and the demo server. |
| `internal/subscriptions` | Starts, changes, cancels and renews subscriptions (`RenewDue` runs every 30 seconds in the server). |
| `internal/webhooks` | Checks endpoint URLs, records events (`Publish`) and sends deliveries (`RunDue`, every 30 seconds). |
| `internal/mail` | Email goes through a `Sender`; `Outbox` keeps messages (tests, demo server). |
| `internal/jobs` | The background job runner. |
| `internal/reports` | The dashboard's reports. |
| `internal/snapshot` | Saves the store to a JSON file and loads it back, migrating files written by older versions. |
| `internal/auth` | Who a request is and what they may do. |
| `internal/api` | The JSON HTTP API, version 1. |
| `internal/apitest` | Builds a whole service with fakes (clock, gateway, outbox, webhook receivers, DNS) and two organizations, for tests. |
| `cmd/tally` | The server: `go run ./cmd/tally -addr :8080 -data tally.json` (prints a demo API key on first start). |

## API conventions

- Every request under `/v1/` sends an API key: `Authorization: Bearer tly_...`. A key acts as the member who created it, in
  that member's organization, with the member's current role (`owner`, `admin`, `billing`, `member`, `viewer`).
- Bodies are JSON. Errors are `{"error": "<code>", "message": "<for people>"}` with the matching status. Another
  organization's object is answered exactly like one that does not exist: 404 `not_found`.
- Lists are `{"items": [...], "next_cursor": "..."}`, oldest first; `?limit=` (1 to 100, default 20) and `?cursor=` page
  through them. `next_cursor` is absent on the last page.
- Times are RFC 3339 in UTC. Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit; fields ending in `_formatted` are for people.
- Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` (the caller's, when it sent a sensible one).

## Working on Tally

- Run the tests with `go test ./...`. Use `apitest.New(t)` for anything that goes through the API; move time with
  `e.Clock`, never with sleeps.
- The admin tool and the integration test suite (both kept in other repositories) use the exported identifiers of these
  packages and the HTTP API. Keep existing exported names, signatures and API fields working; adding new ones is fine.
package api

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"example.com/tally/internal/auth"
	"example.com/tally/internal/billing"
	"example.com/tally/internal/money"
	"example.com/tally/internal/payments"
	"example.com/tally/internal/store"
)

// invoiceView is an invoice as the API shows it: with its totals, a one-line description and its customer.
type invoiceView struct {
	store.Invoice
	billing.Totals
	TotalFormatted string       `json:"total_formatted"`
	Description    string       `json:"description"`
	Customer       *customerRef `json:"customer"`
}

// customerRef is the customer shown on an invoice; null when the customer was deleted.
type customerRef struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}

func newInvoiceView(inv store.Invoice, c *store.Customer) invoiceView {
	t := billing.Compute(inv)
	v := invoiceView{Invoice: inv, Totals: t, TotalFormatted: money.Format(t.Total, inv.Currency), Description: describe(inv.Lines)}
	if c != nil {
		v.Customer = &customerRef{ID: c.ID, Name: c.Name, Email: c.Email}
	}
	return v
}

// describe is the invoice's first line, and how many more there are.
func describe(lines []store.Line) string {
	d := lines[0].Description
	if len(lines) > 1 {
		d += fmt.Sprintf(" and %d more", len(lines)-1)
	}
	return d
}

func (s *Server) viewInvoice(inv store.Invoice) invoiceView {
	if c, ok := s.store.Customer(inv.OrgID, inv.CustomerID); ok {
		return newInvoiceView(inv, &c)
	}
	return newInvoiceView(inv, nil)
}

func findCustomer(cs []store.Customer, id string) *store.Customer {
	for i := range cs {
		if cs[i].ID == id {
			return &cs[i]
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func invoiceViewKey(v invoiceView) cursor { return cursor{T: v.CreatedAt, ID: v.ID} }

// listInvoices lists the organization's invoices, oldest first, optionally only those of ?customer_id=, ?subscription_id=
// or with ?status=.
func (s *Server) listInvoices(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	pg, ok := parsePage(w, r)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	q := r.URL.Query()
	status := store.InvoiceStatus(q.Get("status"))
	if status != "" && status != store.InvoiceOpen && status != store.InvoicePaid && status != store.InvoiceVoid {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_status", "status is open, paid or void")
		return
	}
	invs := s.store.ListInvoices(p.OrgID, store.InvoiceFilter{CustomerID: q.Get("customer_id"), SubscriptionID: q.Get("subscription_id"), Status: status})
	customers := s.store.Customers(p.OrgID)
	views := make([]invoiceView, 0, len(invs))
	for _, inv := range invs {
		views = append(views, newInvoiceView(inv, findCustomer(customers, inv.CustomerID)))
	}
	items, next := pageOf(views, invoiceViewKey, pg)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list{Items: items, NextCursor: next})
}

func (s *Server) createInvoice(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	var in struct {
		CustomerID      string         `json:"customer_id"`
		Currency        money.Currency `json:"currency"`
		Lines           []store.Line   `json:"lines"`
		DiscountPercent int            `json:"discount_percent"`
	}
	if !decode(w, r, &in) {
		return
	}
	if len(in.Lines) == 0 {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid", "an invoice needs at least one line")
		return
	}
	for _, l := range in.Lines {
		if strings.TrimSpace(l.Description) == "" || l.Quantity <= 0 || l.UnitAmount < 0 {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid", "each line needs a description, a positive quantity and a unit amount that is not negative")
			return
		}
	}
	inv, err := s.store.CreateInvoice(store.Invoice{OrgID: p.OrgID, CustomerID: in.CustomerID, Currency: in.Currency, Lines: in.Lines, DiscountPercent: in.DiscountPercent}, s.clock.Now())
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, store.ErrCustomerOrgMismatch) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "customer_org_mismatch", fmt.Sprintf("customer %s belongs to another organization", in.CustomerID))
			return
		}
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "invoice.created", map[string]any{"invoice_id": inv.ID})
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, s.viewInvoice(inv))
}

func (s *Server) getInvoice(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	inv, ok := s.store.Invoice(p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"))
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "no such invoice")
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, s.viewInvoice(inv))
}

// getInvoiceLines answers an invoice's lines with each line's amount, for the dashboard's invoice table.
func (s *Server) getInvoiceLines(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	inv, ok := s.store.InvoiceByID(r.PathValue("id"))
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "no such invoice")
		return
	}
	type lineView struct {
		store.Line
		Amount int64 `json:"amount"`
	}
	items := []lineView{}
	for _, l := range inv.Lines {
		items = append(items, lineView{Line: l, Amount: l.Amount()})
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list{Items: items})
}

// payInvoice charges an invoice: {"payment_method": "pm_..."}, or the customer's default payment method when it is absent.
func (s *Server) payInvoice(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	var in struct {
		PaymentMethod string `json:"payment_method"`
	}
	if r.ContentLength != 0 && !decode(w, r, &in) {
		return
	}
	inv, pay, err := s.pay.Pay(r.Context(), p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"), in.PaymentMethod)
	if err != nil {
		s.payError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"invoice": s.viewInvoice(inv), "payment": pay})
}

func (s *Server) payError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	var decline *payments.DeclineError
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &decline):
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusPaymentRequired, map[string]string{"error": "payment_declined", "decline_code": decline.Code, "message": err.Error()})
	case errors.Is(err, payments.ErrAlreadyPaid):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "already_paid", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, payments.ErrInvoiceVoid):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "invoice_void", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, payments.ErrNoPaymentMethod):
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "no_payment_method", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, payments.ErrUnavailable):
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "gateway_unavailable", "the payment gateway is unavailable; nothing was charged, try again")
	default:
		s.storeError(w, err)
	}
}

func (s *Server) voidInvoice(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	now := s.clock.Now()
	inv, err := s.store.UpdateInvoice(p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"), func(inv *store.Invoice) error {
		switch inv.Status {
		case store.InvoicePaid:
			return payments.ErrAlreadyPaid
		case store.InvoiceVoid:
			return payments.ErrInvoiceVoid
		}
		inv.Status, inv.VoidedAt = store.InvoiceVoid, &now
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		s.payError(w, err)
		return
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "invoice.voided", map[string]any{"invoice_id": inv.ID})
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, s.viewInvoice(inv))
}

func (s *Server) listPayments(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list{Items: s.store.Payments(p.OrgID, r.URL.Query().Get("invoice_id"))})
}
// Package store keeps Tally's data in memory. It is safe for concurrent use.
//
// Every object belongs to one organization. Methods that take an orgID only ever see that organization's objects; the few
// methods that find an object by ID alone (CustomerByID, InvoiceByID, EventByID) are for background jobs and the admin
// tool, which act on behalf of the system rather than a member.
package store

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// Errors. Callers check them with errors.Is; most are wrapped with a detail.
var (
	ErrNotFound      = errors.New("not found")
	ErrInvalid       = errors.New("invalid")
	ErrConflict      = errors.New("conflict")
	ErrEmailTaken    = fmt.Errorf("%w: email address already in use", ErrConflict)
	ErrAlreadyMember = fmt.Errorf("%w: already a member", ErrConflict)
	// ErrCustomerOrgMismatch is returned when an object names a customer of another organization.
	ErrCustomerOrgMismatch = errors.New("customer belongs to another organization")
)

// Store holds everything.
type Store struct {
	mu  sync.Mutex
	seq int

	orgs         map[string]Org
	users        map[string]User
	usersByEmail map[string]string // lower-case email -> user ID
	members      map[memberKey]Member
	apiKeys      map[string]APIKey
	keysByToken  map[string]string // token -> key ID
	invites      map[string]Invite

	customers        map[string]Customer
	customersByEmail map[string]string // lower-case email -> customer ID

	plans     map[string]Plan
	subs      map[string]Subscription
	usage     []UsageRecord
	invoices  map[string]Invoice
	payments  map[string]Payment
	endpoints map[string]WebhookEndpoint
	events    map[string]Event
	delivs    map[string]Delivery
}

type memberKey struct{ org, user string }

// New returns an empty store.
func New() *Store {
	return &Store{
		orgs: map[string]Org{}, users: map[string]User{}, usersByEmail: map[string]string{}, members: map[memberKey]Member{},
		apiKeys: map[string]APIKey{}, keysByToken: map[string]string{}, invites: map[string]Invite{},
		customers: map[string]Customer{}, customersByEmail: map[string]string{},
		plans: map[string]Plan{}, subs: map[string]Subscription{}, invoices: map[string]Invoice{}, payments: map[string]Payment{},
		endpoints: map[string]WebhookEndpoint{}, events: map[string]Event{}, delivs: map[string]Delivery{},
	}
}

// newID returns the next ID with the prefix, for example "cus_000042". The caller holds the lock.
func (s *Store) newID(prefix string) string {
	s.seq++
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s_%06d", prefix, s.seq)
}

// NewToken returns prefix followed by 32 random hex characters.
func NewToken(prefix string) string {
	b := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(b); err != nil {
		panic(err) // crypto/rand does not fail on supported platforms
	}
	return prefix + hex.EncodeToString(b)
}

func normEmail(email string) string { return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(email)) }

func validEmail(email string) bool {
	at := strings.Index(email, "@")
	return at > 0 && at < len(email)-1 && !strings.ContainsAny(email, " \t\r\n,;<>")
}

func invalid(format string, args ...any) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrInvalid, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
}

// ---- organizations

// CreateOrg adds an organization.
func (s *Store) CreateOrg(name string, plan OrgPlan, timeZone string, taxRateBP int, now time.Time) (Org, error) {
	o := Org{Name: strings.TrimSpace(name), Plan: plan, TimeZone: timeZone, TaxRateBP: taxRateBP, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	if err := checkOrg(o); err != nil {
		return Org{}, err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	o.ID = s.newID("org")
	s.orgs[o.ID] = o
	return o, nil
}

func checkOrg(o Org) error {
	if o.Name == "" {
		return invalid("an organization needs a name")
	}
	if !o.Plan.Valid() {
		return invalid("unknown plan %q", o.Plan)
	}
	if _, err := time.LoadLocation(o.TimeZone); err != nil || o.TimeZone == "" {
		return invalid("unknown time zone %q", o.TimeZone)
	}
	if o.TaxRateBP < 0 || o.TaxRateBP > 10000 {
		return invalid("the tax rate is 0 to 10000 basis points")
	}
	return nil
}

// Org returns an organization.
func (s *Store) Org(id string) (Org, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	o, ok := s.orgs[id]
	return o, ok
}

// UpdateOrg changes an organization with f, which may refuse with an error.
func (s *Store) UpdateOrg(id string, f func(*Org) error) (Org, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	o, ok := s.orgs[id]
	if !ok {
		return Org{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if err := f(&o); err != nil {
		return Org{}, err
	}
	o.ID = id
	if err := checkOrg(o); err != nil {
		return Org{}, err
	}
	s.orgs[id] = o
	return o, nil
}

// ---- users and members

// CreateUser adds a user. Email addresses are unique, ignoring case.
func (s *Store) CreateUser(email, name string, now time.Time) (User, error) {
	email, name = strings.TrimSpace(email), strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if !validEmail(email) {
		return User{}, invalid("a user needs a valid email address")
	}
	if name == "" {
		return User{}, invalid("a user needs a name")
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := s.usersByEmail[normEmail(email)]; ok {
		return User{}, ErrEmailTaken
	}
	u := User{ID: s.newID("usr"), Email: email, Name: name, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	s.users[u.ID] = u
	s.usersByEmail[normEmail(email)] = u.ID
	return u, nil
}

// User returns a user.
func (s *Store) User(id string) (User, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	u, ok := s.users[id]
	return u, ok
}

// UserByEmail finds a user by email address, ignoring case.
func (s *Store) UserByEmail(email string) (User, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	id, ok := s.usersByEmail[normEmail(email)]
	if !ok {
		return User{}, false
	}
	return s.users[id], true
}

// AddMember makes a user a member of an organization.
func (s *Store) AddMember(orgID, userID string, role Role, now time.Time) (Member, error) {
	if !role.Valid() {
		return Member{}, invalid("unknown role %q", role)
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.addMember(orgID, userID, role, now)
}

func (s *Store) addMember(orgID, userID string, role Role, now time.Time) (Member, error) {
	if _, ok := s.orgs[orgID]; !ok {
		return Member{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if _, ok := s.users[userID]; !ok {
		return Member{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	k := memberKey{orgID, userID}
	if _, ok := s.members[k]; ok {
		return Member{}, ErrAlreadyMember
	}
	m := Member{OrgID: orgID, UserID: userID, Role: role, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	s.members[k] = m
	return m, nil
}

// Member returns a user's membership of an organization.
func (s *Store) Member(orgID, userID string) (Member, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	m, ok := s.members[memberKey{orgID, userID}]
	return m, ok
}

// Members returns an organization's members, oldest first.
func (s *Store) Members(orgID string) []Member {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	out := []Member{}
	for _, m := range s.members {
		if m.OrgID == orgID {
			out = append(out, m)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
		if !out[i].CreatedAt.Equal(out[j].CreatedAt) {
			return out[i].CreatedAt.Before(out[j].CreatedAt)
		}
		return out[i].UserID < out[j].UserID
	})
	return out
}

// SetMemberRole changes a member's role.
func (s *Store) SetMemberRole(orgID, userID string, role Role) (Member, error) {
	if !role.Valid() {
		return Member{}, invalid("unknown role %q", role)
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	k := memberKey{orgID, userID}
	m, ok := s.members[k]
	if !ok {
		return Member{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	m.Role = role
	s.members[k] = m
	return m, nil
}

// RemoveMember removes a user from an organization. Their API keys for it stop working, as they are no longer a member.
func (s *Store) RemoveMember(orgID, userID string) error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	k := memberKey{orgID, userID}
	if _, ok := s.members[k]; !ok {
		return ErrNotFound
	}
	delete(s.members, k)
	return nil
}

// ---- API keys

// CreateAPIKey gives a member a new API key.
func (s *Store) CreateAPIKey(orgID, userID, name string, now time.Time) (APIKey, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.createAPIKey(orgID, userID, name, now)
}

func (s *Store) createAPIKey(orgID, userID, name string, now time.Time) (APIKey, error) {
	if _, ok := s.members[memberKey{orgID, userID}]; !ok {
		return APIKey{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" {
		name = "API key"
	}
	k := APIKey{ID: s.newID("key"), OrgID: orgID, UserID: userID, Name: name, Token: NewToken("tly_"), CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	s.apiKeys[k.ID] = k
	s.keysByToken[k.Token] = k.ID
	return k, nil
}

// APIKeyByToken finds the key a request presented. Revoked keys are returned too; the caller checks RevokedAt.
func (s *Store) APIKeyByToken(token string) (APIKey, bool) {
	if token == "" {
		return APIKey{}, false
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	id, ok := s.keysByToken[token]
	if !ok {
		return APIKey{}, false
	}
	return s.apiKeys[id], true
}

// APIKey returns one of an organization's keys.
func (s *Store) APIKey(orgID, id string) (APIKey, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	k, ok := s.apiKeys[id]
	if !ok || k.OrgID != orgID {
		return APIKey{}, false
	}
	return k, true
}

// APIKeys returns an organization's keys, oldest first.
func (s *Store) APIKeys(orgID string) []APIKey {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	out := []APIKey{}
	for _, k := range s.apiKeys {
		if k.OrgID == orgID {
			out = append(out, k)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].ID < out[j].ID })
	return out
}

// RevokeAPIKey stops a key from working.
func (s *Store) RevokeAPIKey(orgID, id string, now time.Time) (APIKey, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	k, ok := s.apiKeys[id]
	if !ok || k.OrgID != orgID {
		return APIKey{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if k.RevokedAt == nil {
		t := now.UTC()
		k.RevokedAt = &t
		s.apiKeys[id] = k
	}
	return k, nil
}

// TouchAPIKey records that a key was used.
func (s *Store) TouchAPIKey(id string, now time.Time) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if k, ok := s.apiKeys[id]; ok {
		t := now.UTC()
		k.LastUsedAt = &t
		s.apiKeys[id] = k
	}
}

// ---- invites

// CreateInvite invites an email address to join an organization with a role.
func (s *Store) CreateInvite(orgID, email string, role Role, invitedBy string, now time.Time) (Invite, error) {
	email = strings.TrimSpace(email)
	if !validEmail(email) {
		return Invite{}, invalid("an invite needs a valid email address")
	}
	if !role.Valid() || role == RoleOwner {
		return Invite{}, invalid("an invite's role is admin, billing, member or viewer")
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := s.orgs[orgID]; !ok {
		return Invite{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if uid, ok := s.usersByEmail[normEmail(email)]; ok {
		if _, member := s.members[memberKey{orgID, uid}]; member {
			return Invite{}, ErrAlreadyMember
		}
	}
	inv := Invite{ID: s.newID("inv"), OrgID: orgID, Email: email, Role: role, Token: NewToken("invite_"), InvitedBy: invitedBy, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	s.invites[inv.ID] = inv
	return inv, nil
}

// Invite returns one of an organization's invites.
func (s *Store) Invite(orgID, id string) (Invite, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	inv, ok := s.invites[id]
	if !ok || inv.OrgID != orgID {
		return Invite{}, false
	}
	return inv, true
}

// Invites returns an organization's invites that were neither accepted nor revoked, oldest first.
func (s *Store) Invites(orgID string) []Invite {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	out := []Invite{}
	for _, inv := range s.invites {
		if inv.OrgID == orgID && inv.AcceptedAt == nil && inv.RevokedAt == nil {
			out = append(out, inv)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].ID < out[j].ID })
	return out
}

// RevokeInvite withdraws an invite.
func (s *Store) RevokeInvite(orgID, id string, now time.Time) (Invite, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	inv, ok := s.invites[id]
	if !ok || inv.OrgID != orgID {
		return Invite{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if inv.RevokedAt == nil {
		t := now.UTC()
		inv.RevokedAt = &t
		s.invites[id] = inv
	}
	return inv, nil
}

// AcceptInvite accepts the invite with this token: it finds or creates the user for the invited address (named name),
// makes them a member with the invite's role and gives them a first API key.
func (s *Store) AcceptInvite(token, name string, now time.Time) (User, Member, APIKey, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	var inv Invite
	found := false
	for _, i := range s.invites {
		if i.Token == token && token != "" {
			inv, found = i, true
			break
		}
	}
	if !found || inv.RevokedAt != nil {
		return User{}, Member{}, APIKey{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	var u User
	if id, ok := s.usersByEmail[normEmail(inv.Email)]; ok {
		u = s.users[id]
	} else {
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		if name == "" {
			return User{}, Member{}, APIKey{}, invalid("a new user needs a name")
		}
		u = User{ID: s.newID("usr"), Email: inv.Email, Name: name, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
		s.users[u.ID] = u
		s.usersByEmail[normEmail(u.Email)] = u.ID
	}
	m, err := s.addMember(inv.OrgID, u.ID, inv.Role, now)
	if err != nil {
		return User{}, Member{}, APIKey{}, err
	}
	k, err := s.createAPIKey(inv.OrgID, u.ID, "Default", now)
	if err != nil {
		return User{}, Member{}, APIKey{}, err
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	inv.AcceptedAt = &t
	s.invites[inv.ID] = inv
	return u, m, k, nil
}

@AGENTS.md
# Tally

Tally is a billing platform for SaaS companies. Each organization (a tenant) keeps its customers, sells them plans, bills
them through subscriptions and invoices, takes payments through the payment gateway, and receives webhooks about what
happened. Its own staff work in the organization as members with roles. Go standard library only.

## Layout

| Package | What it does |
|---|---|
| `internal/store` | Everything Tally knows, in memory, safe for concurrent use. Every object belongs to one organization; methods that take an `orgID` only see that organization's objects. |
| `internal/money` | Currencies and amounts. Amounts are `int64` counts of the currency's minor unit (cents for USD), never floats. |
| `internal/billing` | Invoice arithmetic (`Compute`) and billing periods (`AddInterval`). No state. |
| `internal/payments` | Charges invoices through the payment `Gateway`; `Fake` is the gateway of tests and the demo server. |
| `internal/subscriptions` | Starts, changes, cancels and renews subscriptions (`RenewDue` runs every 30 seconds in the server). |
| `internal/webhooks` | Checks endpoint URLs, records events (`Publish`) and sends deliveries (`RunDue`, every 30 seconds). |
| `internal/mail` | Email goes through a `Sender`; `Outbox` keeps messages (tests, demo server). |
| `internal/jobs` | The background job runner. |
| `internal/reports` | The dashboard's reports. |
| `internal/snapshot` | Saves the store to a JSON file and loads it back, migrating files written by older versions. |
| `internal/auth` | Who a request is and what they may do. |
| `internal/api` | The JSON HTTP API, version 1. |
| `internal/apitest` | Builds a whole service with fakes (clock, gateway, outbox, webhook receivers, DNS) and two organizations, for tests. |
| `cmd/tally` | The server: `go run ./cmd/tally -addr :8080 -data tally.json` (prints a demo API key on first start). |

## API conventions

- Every request under `/v1/` sends an API key: `Authorization: Bearer tly_...`. A key acts as the member who created it, in
  that member's organization, with the member's current role (`owner`, `admin`, `billing`, `member`, `viewer`).
- Bodies are JSON. Errors are `{"error": "<code>", "message": "<for people>"}` with the matching status. Another
  organization's object is answered exactly like one that does not exist: 404 `not_found`.
- Lists are `{"items": [...], "next_cursor": "..."}`, oldest first; `?limit=` (1 to 100, default 20) and `?cursor=` page
  through them. `next_cursor` is absent on the last page.
- Times are RFC 3339 in UTC. Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit; fields ending in `_formatted` are for people.
- Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` (the caller's, when it sent a sensible one).

## Working on Tally

- Run the tests with `go test ./...`. Use `apitest.New(t)` for anything that goes through the API; move time with
  `e.Clock`, never with sleeps.
- The admin tool and the integration test suite (both kept in other repositories) use the exported identifiers of these
  packages and the HTTP API. Keep existing exported names, signatures and API fields working; adding new ones is fine.
package api

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"example.com/tally/internal/auth"
	"example.com/tally/internal/billing"
	"example.com/tally/internal/money"
	"example.com/tally/internal/payments"
	"example.com/tally/internal/store"
)

// invoiceView is an invoice as the API shows it: with its totals, a one-line description and its customer.
type invoiceView struct {
	store.Invoice
	billing.Totals
	TotalFormatted string       `json:"total_formatted"`
	Description    string       `json:"description"`
	Customer       *customerRef `json:"customer"`
}

// customerRef is the customer shown on an invoice; null when the customer was deleted.
type customerRef struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}

func newInvoiceView(inv store.Invoice, c *store.Customer) invoiceView {
	t := billing.Compute(inv)
	v := invoiceView{Invoice: inv, Totals: t, TotalFormatted: money.Format(t.Total, inv.Currency), Description: describe(inv.Lines)}
	if c != nil {
		v.Customer = &customerRef{ID: c.ID, Name: c.Name, Email: c.Email}
	}
	return v
}

// describe is the invoice's first line, and how many more there are.
func describe(lines []store.Line) string {
	d := lines[0].Description
	if len(lines) > 1 {
		d += fmt.Sprintf(" and %d more", len(lines)-1)
	}
	return d
}

func (s *Server) viewInvoice(inv store.Invoice) invoiceView {
	if c, ok := s.store.Customer(inv.OrgID, inv.CustomerID); ok {
		return newInvoiceView(inv, &c)
	}
	return newInvoiceView(inv, nil)
}

func findCustomer(cs []store.Customer, id string) *store.Customer {
	for i := range cs {
		if cs[i].ID == id {
			return &cs[i]
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func invoiceViewKey(v invoiceView) cursor { return cursor{T: v.CreatedAt, ID: v.ID} }

// listInvoices lists the organization's invoices, oldest first, optionally only those of ?customer_id=, ?subscription_id=
// or with ?status=.
func (s *Server) listInvoices(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	pg, ok := parsePage(w, r)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	q := r.URL.Query()
	status := store.InvoiceStatus(q.Get("status"))
	if status != "" && status != store.InvoiceOpen && status != store.InvoicePaid && status != store.InvoiceVoid {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_status", "status is open, paid or void")
		return
	}
	invs := s.store.ListInvoices(p.OrgID, store.InvoiceFilter{CustomerID: q.Get("customer_id"), SubscriptionID: q.Get("subscription_id"), Status: status})
	customers := s.store.Customers(p.OrgID)
	views := make([]invoiceView, 0, len(invs))
	for _, inv := range invs {
		views = append(views, newInvoiceView(inv, findCustomer(customers, inv.CustomerID)))
	}
	items, next := pageOf(views, invoiceViewKey, pg)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list{Items: items, NextCursor: next})
}

func (s *Server) createInvoice(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	var in struct {
		CustomerID      string         `json:"customer_id"`
		Currency        money.Currency `json:"currency"`
		Lines           []store.Line   `json:"lines"`
		DiscountPercent int            `json:"discount_percent"`
	}
	if !decode(w, r, &in) {
		return
	}
	if len(in.Lines) == 0 {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid", "an invoice needs at least one line")
		return
	}
	for _, l := range in.Lines {
		if strings.TrimSpace(l.Description) == "" || l.Quantity <= 0 || l.UnitAmount < 0 {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid", "each line needs a description, a positive quantity and a unit amount that is not negative")
			return
		}
	}
	inv, err := s.store.CreateInvoice(store.Invoice{OrgID: p.OrgID, CustomerID: in.CustomerID, Currency: in.Currency, Lines: in.Lines, DiscountPercent: in.DiscountPercent}, s.clock.Now())
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, store.ErrCustomerOrgMismatch) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "customer_org_mismatch", fmt.Sprintf("customer %s belongs to another organization", in.CustomerID))
			return
		}
		s.storeError(w, err)
		return
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "invoice.created", map[string]any{"invoice_id": inv.ID})
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, s.viewInvoice(inv))
}

func (s *Server) getInvoice(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	inv, ok := s.store.Invoice(p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"))
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "no such invoice")
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, s.viewInvoice(inv))
}

// getInvoiceLines answers an invoice's lines with each line's amount, for the dashboard's invoice table.
func (s *Server) getInvoiceLines(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	inv, ok := s.store.InvoiceByID(r.PathValue("id"))
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "no such invoice")
		return
	}
	type lineView struct {
		store.Line
		Amount int64 `json:"amount"`
	}
	items := []lineView{}
	for _, l := range inv.Lines {
		items = append(items, lineView{Line: l, Amount: l.Amount()})
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list{Items: items})
}

// payInvoice charges an invoice: {"payment_method": "pm_..."}, or the customer's default payment method when it is absent.
func (s *Server) payInvoice(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	var in struct {
		PaymentMethod string `json:"payment_method"`
	}
	if r.ContentLength != 0 && !decode(w, r, &in) {
		return
	}
	inv, pay, err := s.pay.Pay(r.Context(), p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"), in.PaymentMethod)
	if err != nil {
		s.payError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"invoice": s.viewInvoice(inv), "payment": pay})
}

func (s *Server) payError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	var decline *payments.DeclineError
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &decline):
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusPaymentRequired, map[string]string{"error": "payment_declined", "decline_code": decline.Code, "message": err.Error()})
	case errors.Is(err, payments.ErrAlreadyPaid):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "already_paid", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, payments.ErrInvoiceVoid):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "invoice_void", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, payments.ErrNoPaymentMethod):
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "no_payment_method", err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, payments.ErrUnavailable):
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "gateway_unavailable", "the payment gateway is unavailable; nothing was charged, try again")
	default:
		s.storeError(w, err)
	}
}

func (s *Server) voidInvoice(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	now := s.clock.Now()
	inv, err := s.store.UpdateInvoice(p.OrgID, r.PathValue("id"), func(inv *store.Invoice) error {
		switch inv.Status {
		case store.InvoicePaid:
			return payments.ErrAlreadyPaid
		case store.InvoiceVoid:
			return payments.ErrInvoiceVoid
		}
		inv.Status, inv.VoidedAt = store.InvoiceVoid, &now
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		s.payError(w, err)
		return
	}
	s.publish(r.Context(), p.OrgID, "invoice.voided", map[string]any{"invoice_id": inv.ID})
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, s.viewInvoice(inv))
}

func (s *Server) listPayments(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, p auth.Principal) {
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, list{Items: s.store.Payments(p.OrgID, r.URL.Query().Get("invoice_id"))})
}
// Package store keeps Tally's data in memory. It is safe for concurrent use.
//
// Every object belongs to one organization. Methods that take an orgID only ever see that organization's objects; the few
// methods that find an object by ID alone (CustomerByID, InvoiceByID, EventByID) are for background jobs and the admin
// tool, which act on behalf of the system rather than a member.
package store

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// Errors. Callers check them with errors.Is; most are wrapped with a detail.
var (
	ErrNotFound      = errors.New("not found")
	ErrInvalid       = errors.New("invalid")
	ErrConflict      = errors.New("conflict")
	ErrEmailTaken    = fmt.Errorf("%w: email address already in use", ErrConflict)
	ErrAlreadyMember = fmt.Errorf("%w: already a member", ErrConflict)
	// ErrCustomerOrgMismatch is returned when an object names a customer of another organization.
	ErrCustomerOrgMismatch = errors.New("customer belongs to another organization")
)

// Store holds everything.
type Store struct {
	mu  sync.Mutex
	seq int

	orgs         map[string]Org
	users        map[string]User
	usersByEmail map[string]string // lower-case email -> user ID
	members      map[memberKey]Member
	apiKeys      map[string]APIKey
	keysByToken  map[string]string // token -> key ID
	invites      map[string]Invite

	customers        map[string]Customer
	customersByEmail map[string]string // lower-case email -> customer ID

	plans     map[string]Plan
	subs      map[string]Subscription
	usage     []UsageRecord
	invoices  map[string]Invoice
	payments  map[string]Payment
	endpoints map[string]WebhookEndpoint
	events    map[string]Event
	delivs    map[string]Delivery
}

type memberKey struct{ org, user string }

// New returns an empty store.
func New() *Store {
	return &Store{
		orgs: map[string]Org{}, users: map[string]User{}, usersByEmail: map[string]string{}, members: map[memberKey]Member{},
		apiKeys: map[string]APIKey{}, keysByToken: map[string]string{}, invites: map[string]Invite{},
		customers: map[string]Customer{}, customersByEmail: map[string]string{},
		plans: map[string]Plan{}, subs: map[string]Subscription{}, invoices: map[string]Invoice{}, payments: map[string]Payment{},
		endpoints: map[string]WebhookEndpoint{}, events: map[string]Event{}, delivs: map[string]Delivery{},
	}
}

// newID returns the next ID with the prefix, for example "cus_000042". The caller holds the lock.
func (s *Store) newID(prefix string) string {
	s.seq++
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s_%06d", prefix, s.seq)
}

// NewToken returns prefix followed by 32 random hex characters.
func NewToken(prefix string) string {
	b := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(b); err != nil {
		panic(err) // crypto/rand does not fail on supported platforms
	}
	return prefix + hex.EncodeToString(b)
}

func normEmail(email string) string { return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(email)) }

func validEmail(email string) bool {
	at := strings.Index(email, "@")
	return at > 0 && at < len(email)-1 && !strings.ContainsAny(email, " \t\r\n,;<>")
}

func invalid(format string, args ...any) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrInvalid, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
}

// ---- organizations

// CreateOrg adds an organization.
func (s *Store) CreateOrg(name string, plan OrgPlan, timeZone string, taxRateBP int, now time.Time) (Org, error) {
	o := Org{Name: strings.TrimSpace(name), Plan: plan, TimeZone: timeZone, TaxRateBP: taxRateBP, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	if err := checkOrg(o); err != nil {
		return Org{}, err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	o.ID = s.newID("org")
	s.orgs[o.ID] = o
	return o, nil
}

func checkOrg(o Org) error {
	if o.Name == "" {
		return invalid("an organization needs a name")
	}
	if !o.Plan.Valid() {
		return invalid("unknown plan %q", o.Plan)
	}
	if _, err := time.LoadLocation(o.TimeZone); err != nil || o.TimeZone == "" {
		return invalid("unknown time zone %q", o.TimeZone)
	}
	if o.TaxRateBP < 0 || o.TaxRateBP > 10000 {
		return invalid("the tax rate is 0 to 10000 basis points")
	}
	return nil
}

// Org returns an organization.
func (s *Store) Org(id string) (Org, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	o, ok := s.orgs[id]
	return o, ok
}

// UpdateOrg changes an organization with f, which may refuse with an error.
func (s *Store) UpdateOrg(id string, f func(*Org) error) (Org, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	o, ok := s.orgs[id]
	if !ok {
		return Org{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if err := f(&o); err != nil {
		return Org{}, err
	}
	o.ID = id
	if err := checkOrg(o); err != nil {
		return Org{}, err
	}
	s.orgs[id] = o
	return o, nil
}

// ---- users and members

// CreateUser adds a user. Email addresses are unique, ignoring case.
func (s *Store) CreateUser(email, name string, now time.Time) (User, error) {
	email, name = strings.TrimSpace(email), strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if !validEmail(email) {
		return User{}, invalid("a user needs a valid email address")
	}
	if name == "" {
		return User{}, invalid("a user needs a name")
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := s.usersByEmail[normEmail(email)]; ok {
		return User{}, ErrEmailTaken
	}
	u := User{ID: s.newID("usr"), Email: email, Name: name, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	s.users[u.ID] = u
	s.usersByEmail[normEmail(email)] = u.ID
	return u, nil
}

// User returns a user.
func (s *Store) User(id string) (User, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	u, ok := s.users[id]
	return u, ok
}

// UserByEmail finds a user by email address, ignoring case.
func (s *Store) UserByEmail(email string) (User, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	id, ok := s.usersByEmail[normEmail(email)]
	if !ok {
		return User{}, false
	}
	return s.users[id], true
}

// AddMember makes a user a member of an organization.
func (s *Store) AddMember(orgID, userID string, role Role, now time.Time) (Member, error) {
	if !role.Valid() {
		return Member{}, invalid("unknown role %q", role)
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.addMember(orgID, userID, role, now)
}

func (s *Store) addMember(orgID, userID string, role Role, now time.Time) (Member, error) {
	if _, ok := s.orgs[orgID]; !ok {
		return Member{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if _, ok := s.users[userID]; !ok {
		return Member{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	k := memberKey{orgID, userID}
	if _, ok := s.members[k]; ok {
		return Member{}, ErrAlreadyMember
	}
	m := Member{OrgID: orgID, UserID: userID, Role: role, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	s.members[k] = m
	return m, nil
}

// Member returns a user's membership of an organization.
func (s *Store) Member(orgID, userID string) (Member, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	m, ok := s.members[memberKey{orgID, userID}]
	return m, ok
}

// Members returns an organization's members, oldest first.
func (s *Store) Members(orgID string) []Member {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	out := []Member{}
	for _, m := range s.members {
		if m.OrgID == orgID {
			out = append(out, m)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
		if !out[i].CreatedAt.Equal(out[j].CreatedAt) {
			return out[i].CreatedAt.Before(out[j].CreatedAt)
		}
		return out[i].UserID < out[j].UserID
	})
	return out
}

// SetMemberRole changes a member's role.
func (s *Store) SetMemberRole(orgID, userID string, role Role) (Member, error) {
	if !role.Valid() {
		return Member{}, invalid("unknown role %q", role)
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	k := memberKey{orgID, userID}
	m, ok := s.members[k]
	if !ok {
		return Member{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	m.Role = role
	s.members[k] = m
	return m, nil
}

// RemoveMember removes a user from an organization. Their API keys for it stop working, as they are no longer a member.
func (s *Store) RemoveMember(orgID, userID string) error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	k := memberKey{orgID, userID}
	if _, ok := s.members[k]; !ok {
		return ErrNotFound
	}
	delete(s.members, k)
	return nil
}

// ---- API keys

// CreateAPIKey gives a member a new API key.
func (s *Store) CreateAPIKey(orgID, userID, name string, now time.Time) (APIKey, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.createAPIKey(orgID, userID, name, now)
}

func (s *Store) createAPIKey(orgID, userID, name string, now time.Time) (APIKey, error) {
	if _, ok := s.members[memberKey{orgID, userID}]; !ok {
		return APIKey{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" {
		name = "API key"
	}
	k := APIKey{ID: s.newID("key"), OrgID: orgID, UserID: userID, Name: name, Token: NewToken("tly_"), CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	s.apiKeys[k.ID] = k
	s.keysByToken[k.Token] = k.ID
	return k, nil
}

// APIKeyByToken finds the key a request presented. Revoked keys are returned too; the caller checks RevokedAt.
func (s *Store) APIKeyByToken(token string) (APIKey, bool) {
	if token == "" {
		return APIKey{}, false
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	id, ok := s.keysByToken[token]
	if !ok {
		return APIKey{}, false
	}
	return s.apiKeys[id], true
}

// APIKey returns one of an organization's keys.
func (s *Store) APIKey(orgID, id string) (APIKey, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	k, ok := s.apiKeys[id]
	if !ok || k.OrgID != orgID {
		return APIKey{}, false
	}
	return k, true
}

// APIKeys returns an organization's keys, oldest first.
func (s *Store) APIKeys(orgID string) []APIKey {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	out := []APIKey{}
	for _, k := range s.apiKeys {
		if k.OrgID == orgID {
			out = append(out, k)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].ID < out[j].ID })
	return out
}

// RevokeAPIKey stops a key from working.
func (s *Store) RevokeAPIKey(orgID, id string, now time.Time) (APIKey, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	k, ok := s.apiKeys[id]
	if !ok || k.OrgID != orgID {
		return APIKey{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if k.RevokedAt == nil {
		t := now.UTC()
		k.RevokedAt = &t
		s.apiKeys[id] = k
	}
	return k, nil
}

// TouchAPIKey records that a key was used.
func (s *Store) TouchAPIKey(id string, now time.Time) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if k, ok := s.apiKeys[id]; ok {
		t := now.UTC()
		k.LastUsedAt = &t
		s.apiKeys[id] = k
	}
}

// ---- invites

// CreateInvite invites an email address to join an organization with a role.
func (s *Store) CreateInvite(orgID, email string, role Role, invitedBy string, now time.Time) (Invite, error) {
	email = strings.TrimSpace(email)
	if !validEmail(email) {
		return Invite{}, invalid("an invite needs a valid email address")
	}
	if !role.Valid() || role == RoleOwner {
		return Invite{}, invalid("an invite's role is admin, billing, member or viewer")
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := s.orgs[orgID]; !ok {
		return Invite{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if uid, ok := s.usersByEmail[normEmail(email)]; ok {
		if _, member := s.members[memberKey{orgID, uid}]; member {
			return Invite{}, ErrAlreadyMember
		}
	}
	inv := Invite{ID: s.newID("inv"), OrgID: orgID, Email: email, Role: role, Token: NewToken("invite_"), InvitedBy: invitedBy, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
	s.invites[inv.ID] = inv
	return inv, nil
}

// Invite returns one of an organization's invites.
func (s *Store) Invite(orgID, id string) (Invite, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	inv, ok := s.invites[id]
	if !ok || inv.OrgID != orgID {
		return Invite{}, false
	}
	return inv, true
}

// Invites returns an organization's invites that were neither accepted nor revoked, oldest first.
func (s *Store) Invites(orgID string) []Invite {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	out := []Invite{}
	for _, inv := range s.invites {
		if inv.OrgID == orgID && inv.AcceptedAt == nil && inv.RevokedAt == nil {
			out = append(out, inv)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].ID < out[j].ID })
	return out
}

// RevokeInvite withdraws an invite.
func (s *Store) RevokeInvite(orgID, id string, now time.Time) (Invite, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	inv, ok := s.invites[id]
	if !ok || inv.OrgID != orgID {
		return Invite{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if inv.RevokedAt == nil {
		t := now.UTC()
		inv.RevokedAt = &t
		s.invites[id] = inv
	}
	return inv, nil
}

// AcceptInvite accepts the invite with this token: it finds or creates the user for the invited address (named name),
// makes them a member with the invite's role and gives them a first API key.
func (s *Store) AcceptInvite(token, name string, now time.Time) (User, Member, APIKey, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	var inv Invite
	found := false
	for _, i := range s.invites {
		if i.Token == token && token != "" {
			inv, found = i, true
			break
		}
	}
	if !found || inv.RevokedAt != nil {
		return User{}, Member{}, APIKey{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	var u User
	if id, ok := s.usersByEmail[normEmail(inv.Email)]; ok {
		u = s.users[id]
	} else {
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		if name == "" {
			return User{}, Member{}, APIKey{}, invalid("a new user needs a name")
		}
		u = User{ID: s.newID("usr"), Email: inv.Email, Name: name, CreatedAt: now.UTC()}
		s.users[u.ID] = u
		s.usersByEmail[normEmail(u.Email)] = u.ID
	}
	m, err := s.addMember(inv.OrgID, u.ID, inv.Role, now)
	if err != nil {
		return User{}, Member{}, APIKey{}, err
	}
	k, err := s.createAPIKey(inv.OrgID, u.ID, "Default", now)
	if err != nil {
		return User{}, Member{}, APIKey{}, err
	}
	t := now.UTC()
	inv.AcceptedAt = &t
	s.invites[inv.ID] = inv
	return u, m, k, nil
}
